research_goal: Which solar/season-associated temporal movement contrasts repeat across source field studies and taxa, and which source-level Sun-relative movement bearings vary by geography, climate and sampling support?

hypothesis_family.H1: Ecological temporal allocation can recur across source field-study populations even where raw solar-relative movement bearing differs.
hypothesis_family.H2: Raw solar-relative bearing can be partly determined by source geographic heading marginals, not a universally aligned solar compass.
hypothesis_family.H3: Actual ERA5 irradiance×temporal-use association cannot be inferred without within-source observations across the same individual-time exposure frame.
hypothesis_family.H4: Independent-source ecological generality must be evaluated separately for each temporal, movement, weather and detection endpoint, with nonreplicated/null/unsupported archives retained.

immutable_frozen_data: Verify all eight inputs against the original migration manifest per-file Git blob SHA before computing results. A mismatch fails closed.

primary_6_source_taxon_rows.source_unit: Original Movebank study DOI; for taxon-specific estimands study×native taxon, not independent world ecosystems.
primary_6_source_taxon_rows.identity_key: Exact original DOI plus exact native scientific taxon string; never join by state, common name, geography or partial DOI.
primary_6_source_taxon_rows.source_level_temporal_endpoint: Within-animal-year slope of q=log1p(minimum GPS night-speed)-log1p(minimum GPS daytime speed), per modeled astronomical daylength hour; original source animal bootstrap intervals.
primary_6_source_taxon_rows.separate_source_level_movement_endpoint: Equal original source animal mean cos(GPS displacement travel bearing minus instantaneous Sun azimuth), decomposed into geographic marginal and joint component. Original source animal bootstrap descriptive intervals.
primary_6_source_taxon_rows.unknown_or_nonidentical: Daylength and bearing estimands do not necessarily use the same source animal or GPS intervals and are not a joint individual-level covariance.
primary_6_source_taxon_rows.pair_rule: Only two taxa have two distinct original study DOI sources. Show both. Do not select by previous sign.
primary_6_source_taxon_rows.source_bootstrap_interpretation: Original conditional individual sampling support. No formal world-taxonomy source p-value, and observational CIs must not be used as proof of biological equivalence.

secondary_original_nine_taxa.input: Previously frozen nine taxa with exactly two distinct original GPS archive sources
secondary_original_nine_taxa.source_unit: same taxon×original study; 9 taxa but not 18 mutually independent ecosystems
estimands: sign agreement of raw solar-relative alignment
sign agreement of joint circular covariance
sign agreement of within solar clock covariance
secondary_original_nine_taxa.policy: All 9 preserved, not only taxa with sign changes; distinguish raw marginal geometry from joint covariance.

cross_literature_source_nonoverlap.radiation_frame: 24+24 fixed original archive sources with 10+10 estimable signed radiation slopes
cross_literature_source_nonoverlap.missingness: Retain all 28 source holds as UNDEFINED, never substitute zero or select favorable sources.
cross_literature_source_nonoverlap.joint_axis_inference: Only infer a joint radiation–temporal niche relationship if exactly matching original study DOI and individual-time support exists. If intersection is empty or unsupported, report NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.

next_research_route.primary_scientific_estimand: Within-source and within-individual association of both P(day/night displacement) and solar-relative travel vector with shortwave anomalies at matched true solar altitude, fine apparent solar time, geographic corridors and season.
next_research_route.radiation_residual: R−E(R | true solar altitude, continuous apparent solar time, season/year, original local geography), using original hourly weather. This is conditional variation, not sunlight causality.
next_research_route.direction: cos and sin of bearing−solar azimuth, plus step speed and route bearing marginal
requirements: Pre-freeze source and original animal/time eligibility
Full source/provider MD5 replay before new weather
Source/group uncertainty, not GPS-fix iid tests
Camera photo-time bias q remains explicit

privacy_and_rights: Only group-derived summaries and original study DOI; never release raw GPS positions, individual identifiers, exact UTC observation times, full third-party original track or restricted source file.
scientific_reporting_level: Exploratory posthoc original-source ecological decomposition, not preregistered cross-axis ecology or solar compass causation.
